article.story: RUSTON, La. -- — Braylon Wenger scored 16 points as Louisiana Tech beat Alcorn State 83-41 on Tuesday night. Wenger shot 5 for 10 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Bulldogs (5-2). Kyran Tilley shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 1 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 5 from the line to add 12 points. Adam Boyd had 12 points and shot 4 of 9 from the field and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line. Braylhan Thomas led the Braves (0-7) in scoring, finishing with nine points and six rebounds. Ma’Kye Taylor added six points for Alcorn State. Saxby Sunderland also had five points. The loss is the eighth straight dating to last season for the Braves. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
